turns.q: Can it arrive gift-ready, and how fast can it ship?
turns.replyTail:
Yes, it can arrive gift-ready. At checkout, you can add a personal gift message and choose signature gift packaging.

For shipping, most orders ship within 1–2 business days. Standard delivery is typically 3–7 business days after shipment in the US and Canada. In the US, express shipping is available for 1–2 business-day delivery after shipment. Exact options and timing appear at checkout based on the destination.
